# Vector Trade Capital

Vector Trade Capital is an international trade company specializing in commodity sourcing, trade finance, and import/export solutions for Caribbean businesses.

## Website

https://vectortradecapital.com

## About

Vector Trade Capital provides:
- International commodity sourcing (fuel, food, agricultural products)
- Trade finance solutions (letters of credit, supplier financing, PO financing)
- Import/export consulting and logistics
- Caribbean market expertise and supplier networks

## Services

- **Fuel & Energy Imports**: Diesel, gasoline, and energy product sourcing
- **Food Commodity Sourcing**: Rice, sugar, cooking oils, frozen poultry, and other bulk food items
- **Trade Finance**: Letters of credit, supplier credit lines, purchase order financing, pre-export financing
- **Principal Trading**: Direct sourcing from commodity principals with volume discounts
- **Logistics & Compliance**: Port operations, documentation, customs clearance

## Trade Desk

### [Trade Desk — Direct Access to Sourcing & Pricing](trade-desk.html)
Vector Trade Capital's trade desk is the operational core of the company. When a buyer submits an inquiry, it goes directly to the Houston-based trading team — not a contact form queue or outsourced call center. The same person who reviews the inquiry sources the product, negotiates with suppliers, arranges freight and insurance, and coordinates documentation. Quote turnaround is 48 hours for standard commodities (rice, sugar, cooking oil, frozen poultry, diesel, gasoline). Vector Trade Capital is a principal trader that finances every transaction from its own balance sheet — no third-party broker layers, no external funding delays. Minimum orders start at one container load (~25 metric tons). Payment terms include letters of credit, documents against acceptance, and open account for established buyers.

### [Haiti Commodity Supplier](haiti-commodity-supplier.html)
Bulk commodity supply to Haiti. CIF delivery of rice, black beans, cooking oil, milk powder, diesel, and gasoline to Port-au-Prince and Cap-Haïtien. For qualified commercial buyers, distributors, and importers. Fuel transactions evaluated on a per-transaction basis with appropriate compliance review.

Finding the right fuel supplier is foundational to a successful import operation. Learn critical evaluation criteria — capital structure, logistics control, inspection capabilities, delivery reliability, pricing transparency, and communication.

### [Understanding Caribbean Fuel Pricing & CIF Quotes](blog/caribbean-fuel-pricing-cif-explained.html)
Break down the components of a fuel CIF quote: base petroleum cost, refining margins, freight, marine insurance, terminal fees. Includes pricing optimization strategies and real-world examples.
Published: March 23, 2026

### [Principal Trader vs Broker in Commodity Imports](blog/principal-trader-vs-broker-commodity-imports.html)
Key differences between principal traders (owner-traders) and brokers (intermediaries). Understand pricing, risk, reliability, and when to source directly from principals versus working with brokers.
Published: March 23, 2026

### [Trade Finance Solutions for Caribbean Commodity Imports](blog/trade-finance-caribbean-commodity-imports.html)
Complete toolkit for trade finance: letters of credit, supplier credit lines, purchase order financing, and pre-export financing. Strategies for integrating trade finance with sourcing operations.
Published: March 23, 2026

### [Emergency & Disaster Relief Supply](blog/emergency-supply.html)
Emergency fuel and food supply for Caribbean disaster relief. Rapid deployment of diesel, gasoline, rice, and essential commodities to affected ports during hurricanes and natural disasters. Covers emergency supply chains, disaster preparedness, and rapid commodity procurement strategies for Caribbean importers.
Published: March 23, 2026
